messages:
Elliot: Anyone up for a low-lag LAN tomorrow? Thinking Deep Rock Galactic co-op (PC) + TowerFall or local party indies. Need a few things: 1 spare router/switch or a 5m ethernet, and 2 controllers that map to Steam.
Samir: I can bring a 5-port unmanaged switch and a 5m Cat6. Also have an Xbox One pad wired.
Jules: I have 2 Bluetooth controllers that pair to Steam, but they sometimes need the Steam "Controller Setup" enabled. Pro tip: add -novid to launch options for quick loading.
Fiona: I'll bring my gaming PC (can host DRG lobby) and a PS4 pad. Also snacks (pretzels).
Elliot: Amazing. Do we want to do a quick stress test of network before people arrive? I can run a tiny local server to test port-forwarding.
Samir: Yes please. If you're hosting an external lobby, remember to forward ports 27015-27030 UDP/TCP depending on the game. If you want a quick static IP for testing, set one like 10.0.7.50.
Jules: For folks on mac/linux:```
sudo ifconfig en0 10.0.7.50 netmask 255.255.255.0
# undo: sudo dhclient en0
```
Elliot: Thanks. Lounge reservation: lounge-bot reserved "Commons" 18:30-23:00.
lounge-bot: Room "Commons" reserved by Elliot 18:30-23:00 tomorrow.
Fiona: Quick compatibility note: TowerFall runs best in windowed borderless for local controllers. Turn Vsync off if you want microstutter-free input.
Samir: Can someone bring an HDMI->DisplayPort adapter? My laptop has only DP out.
Jules: I have one. Bringing it.
Elliot: Snack poll (react): chips :potato:, pretzels :pretzel:, fruit :banana:, cookies :cookie:. I'll coordinate.
- Fiona: :pretzel:
- Samir: :potato:
- Jules: :cookie:
Elliot: Also thinking of a tiny prize: custom enamel pin for the DRG captain. Agree?
Fiona: Yes. Also can we keep a "quiet zone" for people streaming or on calls? I can set up a sign.
Samir: Good call. We'll put the Streamers/Quiet area by the high table.
Jules: If anyone's doing Steam Remote Play, use the guest SSID (LAN-GUEST) to avoid policies. And if you want lower latency, prefer wired and set the adapter metric higher:```
# windows (admin)
netsh interface ipv4 set interface "Ethernet" metric=10
netsh interface ipv4 set interface "Wi-Fi" metric=50
```
Elliot: Sweet. Final plan: set up 18:15, network test 18:30-18:45, warm-up co-op at 19:00, TowerFall after. Message me if you can bring extra controllers.
Samir: Bringing an Xbox pad and the switch.
Jules: Bringing DP adapter + 2 BT pads + USB hub.
Fiona: PC + snacks + power strip.
Elliot: Thanks y'all. See you tomorrow :game_die:
